items.title: Committed evidence-map generator with hermetic selfcheck
items.context: Create experiments/experience-ablation/evidence-map.mjs: CLI (node evidence-map.mjs --root=<repoRoot> --experimentId=<id> [--out=<dir>] [--generatedAt=<iso>]) that reads the experiment evidence root and emits evidence-map.json + evidence-map.md containing: (1) the claim-to-artifact table covering every plan-section-18 row, each row carrying the artifact path, an existence check, and a sha256 digest (or the recorded hash where the artifact self-declares one, cross-checked); (2) the no-overclaim summary with the circularity disclosure (in-store traps authored from the same lesson store the treatment surfaces) and the four disallowed claims from plan section 15; (3) the final study summary: causal verdict INCONCLUSIVE with the invalidated-assumption basis and the skip_powered_study decision reference; (4) the plan-section-16 paper table filled from score-records.jsonl (control/treatment defect rates per trap group, paired risk difference marked unpowered/exploratory, time/cost deltas where computable) with an explicit unpowered label on every inferential-looking figure. Deterministic (generatedAt input-only, stable ordering). Create evidence-map-selfcheck.mjs (hermetic, mkdtemp stubs): table covers all section-18 rows, every cited artifact existence+digest-checked (a missing artifact fails with one actionable line), circularity disclosure + disallowed claims present, verdict line present, unpowered labels on all paper-table figures, deterministic double-run byte-identity.
items.userSees: node experiments/experience-ablation/evidence-map-selfcheck.mjs prints per-case PASS lines ending evidence-map-selfcheck: all cases passed with exit 0

happy.desc: Selfcheck: map covers all section-18 rows with existence+digest-checked artifacts, circularity disclosure + disallowed claims + verdict line present

edge.desc: Deterministic double-run byte-identity; a missing cited artifact fails with one actionable line

adversarial.desc: Paper-table figures all carry unpowered/exploratory labels; the tool writes only under --out and never mutates cited artifacts

verificationEvidence.note: Selfcheck run twice, 37/37 PASS both runs, exit 0: section-18 rows all present in order with status ok; every required artifact + plan doc cited with existence check and recomputed sha256; circularity disclosure, four plan-15 disallowed claims, and exact verdict line Causal impact: INCONCLUSIVE asserted in json + md.

Determinism cases PASS: double run byte-identical for json + md with --generatedAt, and without the flag generatedAt records null while staying byte-identical. Missing-artifact loop PASS: each of the 12 required evidence artifacts plus the plan document, when omitted from a hermetic stub root, fails with exactly one actionable stderr line prefixed evidence-map: naming the artifact.

Adversarial cases PASS: every paper-table figure row carries inference unpowered/exploratory in JSON and the [unpowered/exploratory] label on all 3 md table rows; recursive tree digest before/after proves nothing outside --out was created or modified (cited artifacts never mutated); tamper cases detected (protocol payload edit -> protocolHash recompute mismatch, manifest append -> manifestHash mismatch, snapshot edit -> memorySnapshotHash recompute mismatch, drifted score records -> pilot baseline recount mismatch); fail-closed guard when n-freeze verdict is not refused.

items.title: Generate and persist the final M9 evidence map for expabl-m6-pilot-v1
items.context: Run the committed tool against the real evidence root: node experiments/experience-ablation/evidence-map.mjs --root=<mainRepo> --experimentId=expabl-m6-pilot-v1 --out=<evidenceRoot>. Verify evidence-map.md: the claim-to-artifact table lists every section-18 row with existing digest-checked artifacts (protocol.json hash 22705b73, snapshot hash f5c7d4be, sealed run order, 45-fixture leakage audit, 90 score records with replay digest 8cea1902, n-freeze refusal, m7-decision, live-readout), the no-overclaim + circularity text is present, the final verdict reads INCONCLUSIVE with the basis, and the paper table carries unpowered labels. Persist both files under the evidence root.
items.userSees: ls .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/expabl-m6-pilot-v1/ shows evidence-map.json and evidence-map.md; head of evidence-map.md shows the claim-to-artifact table and the final verdict line Causal impact: INCONCLUSIVE

happy.desc: Real evidence-map.md lists every section-18 row with existing digest-checked artifacts (protocol 22705b73, snapshot f5c7d4be, replay digest 8cea1902, refusal, m7-decision, live-readout)

edge.desc: evidence-map.json parses and mirrors the md (spot-check keys/figures)

adversarial.desc: Final verdict line reads Causal impact: INCONCLUSIVE with the invalidated-assumption basis; every paper-table figure labeled unpowered

verificationEvidence.note: evidence-map.md claim-to-artifact table lists all 10 plan-section-18 rows, every artifact exists with sha256 recorded and status ok (protocol.json, protocol-config, memory-snapshot-hash, fixture-manifest, pair-ledger, run-order-seed, score-records, leakage-audit, n-freeze, m7-decision, live-readout pair, self rows).
evidence-map.json parses; content mirrors the md (rows/figures spot-checked).

verificationEvidence.command: grep -n Causal impact evidence-map.md; grep -c unpowered
verificationEvidence.note: Final verdict line 83: Causal impact: INCONCLUSIVE with the invalidated-assumption basis; paper-table figures carry unpowered labels; circularity disclosure and the four disallowed claims present.
